```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

d_gps <- 
  read_csv(here(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_gps_2023-07-31.csv")) %>%
  rename(lat = median_latitude,
         lon = median_longitude)

grappe_phase_mort <- 
  readRDS(paste0(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_phase_2023-07-31.rds"))

```

### Collapse `grappe_phase_mort` to grappe-level outcome measures.
```{r}

grappe_mort <- 
  grappe_phase_mort %>%
  group_by(region, district, site_code, grappe,
           adaptive_rand, tx) %>%
  summarise(started_phase_1to59 = sum(started_phase_1to59, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_1to59 = sum(pt_year_1to59, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_1to59 = sum(n_deaths_1to59, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_1to59 = sum(n_alive_1to59, na.rm=T),
            lost_1to59 = sum(lost_1to59, na.rm=T),
            
            started_phase_1to11 = sum(started_phase_1to11, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_1to11 = sum(pt_year_1to11, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_1to11 = sum(n_deaths_1to11, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_1to11 = sum(n_alive_1to11, na.rm=T),
            lost_1to11 = sum(lost_1to11, na.rm=T),
            
            started_phase_12to59 = sum(started_phase_12to59, na.rm=T),
            pt_year_12to59 = sum(pt_year_12to59, na.rm=T),
            n_deaths_12to59 = sum(n_deaths_12to59, na.rm=T),
            n_alive_12to59 = sum(n_alive_12to59, na.rm=T),
            lost_12to59 = sum(lost_12to59, na.rm=T),
            
            deaths_per_1000_1to59 = n_deaths_1to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to59,
            deaths_per_1000_1to11 = n_deaths_1to11 * 1e3 / pt_year_1to11,
            deaths_per_1000_12to59 = n_deaths_12to59 * 1e3 / pt_year_12to59)

grappe_mort

length(unique(grappe_phase_mort$site_code))
length(unique(d_gps$site_code))

## d_gps has 2 more rows than grappe_mort
d_gps %>% dplyr::filter(!site_code %in% grappe_mort$site_code) %>% pull(grappe)

```

### Join gps to outcome data
```{r}
d_gps_latlon <-
  d_gps %>%
  dplyr::select(site_code, lat, lon)

grappe_mort_1 <- grappe_mort %>%
    left_join(d_gps_latlon, by=c("site_code")) %>%
  relocate(lat, .after=grappe) %>%
  relocate(lon, .after=grappe)

# confirm it was a clean 1:1 join
nrow(grappe_mort_1) == nrow(grappe_mort)
# nrow(grappe_mort_1) == nrow(d_gps) 

# Recode tx labels to align with ms nomenclature
grappe_mort_2 <- grappe_mort_1 %>%
  mutate(
  tx = case_when(
    tx == "1 - Azithro 1-59m" ~ "Child Azithro",
    tx == "2 - Azithro 1-11m" ~ "Infant Azithro",
    tx == "3 - Placebo 1-59m" ~ "Placebo"),
  
  isTreated_child = case_when(
    tx == "Child Azithro" ~ "Treatment",
    .default = "Control"
    ),
  
  isTreated_alltx = case_when(
    tx == "Placebo" ~ "Control",
    .default = "Treatment"
    ),
  
  tx = factor(tx, 
              levels = c("Child Azithro","Infant Azithro","Placebo")),
  
  isTreated_child = factor(isTreated_child, 
                           levels = c("Control","Treatment")),
  
  isTreated_alltx = factor(isTreated_alltx, 
                           levels = c("Control","Treatment"))
  
  
  ) %>%
  # shorten adaptive randomization labels
  mutate(adaptive_rand = factor(adaptive_rand, 
                                levels = c("Random Allocation 1", 
                                           "Random Allocation 2", 
                                           "Random Allocation 3"),
                                labels = c("Randomization 1", 
                                           "Randomization 2", 
                                           "Randomization 3")),
         #add dummy var
         dummy = 1 
         )

# -------------------------
# Don't store final dataset
# locally--PHI
# -------------------------

grappe_gps_mort <- 
  grappe_mort_2 %>%
  filter(adaptive_rand %in% c("Randomization 1", "Randomization 2", "Randomization 3"))

grappe_gps_mort$isTreated_child <- relevel(grappe_gps_mort$isTreated_child, ref = "Control")

df_all <- grappe_gps_mort
df_tx1 <- grappe_gps_mort %>% filter(as.integer(tx)==1)
df_tx2 <- grappe_gps_mort %>% filter(as.integer(tx)==2)
df_tx3 <- grappe_gps_mort %>% filter(as.integer(tx)==3)

df_all

# --------------------------------------------------
# Check that the binary treatment variables were 
# properly assigned
# --------------------------------------------------
df_all %>% group_by(tx,isTreated_child) %>% summarise(n=n())
df_all %>% group_by(tx,isTreated_alltx) %>% summarise(n=n())

# --------------------------------------------------
# See frequencies across districts
# --------------------------------------------------
df_all %>% group_by(district,isTreated_child) %>% summarise(n=n())
df_all %>% group_by(district,isTreated_child) %>% summarise(n=n())

```

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Rename districts to match shapefile district names
# --------------------------------------------------
df_all$district[df_all$district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)"] <- "Tibiri"
df_all$district[df_all$district=="Illela"] <- "Illéla"

saveRDS(df_all, here("data", "mortality_analysis_dataset.rds"))

```

```{r}

#-------------------------------
# format grappe data as sf
#-------------------------------
d_sf <- st_as_sf(grappe_gps_mort, 
                 coords = c("lon","lat"), 
                 crs    = 4326) # set coordinate ref system to WGS84

d_sf$district[d_sf$district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)"] <- "Tibiri"
d_sf$district[d_sf$district=="Illela"] <- "Illéla"

saveRDS(d_sf, here("data", "grappes_sf.rds"))

```
